name: Escape from Sin City
storyline:
You play as a man of faith trapped in a college ravaged by a zombie apocalypse in the desolate town of Basin City. With no one else alive, your goal is to escape by solving logic-based puzzles, cracking codes, and using tools across multiple eerie locations. The game emphasizes urgency and survival, with the haunting quote:

“We always think there's gonna be more time... then it runs out.”
summary: Escape from Sin City is a challenging escape-room style adventure set in the grim and desolate town of Basin City. You play as a lone survivor — a man of faith — navigating a college ravaged by a zombie apocalypse. The game emphasizes logic-based puzzles, code-cracking, and item usage across multiple eerie locations. With a dark narrative tone and horror elements, players must escape before time runs out.
